```{r}
rm(list=ls())
library(tidyverse)
library(plyr); library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(DESeq2)
#library(tximport)
library(readxl)
library("vsn")
library(EnhancedVolcano)
library(pheatmap)
library(purrr)
library(TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
library(tracktables)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(ChIPseeker)
library(RcisTarget)
library(UpSetR)
library(rGREAT)

library(DT)

```

1. Load datasets
```{r}
dir <- "~/Partners HealthCare Dropbox/Ning Guan/Lab Work- Alexa Mitchell/ATAC-seq CUTnRUN/BPPNM luc-mCherry Int2 ATAC"
meta <- read.table(file.path(dir,"Analysis/BPPNM_luc_mCherry_Meta.csv"), sep=",",header=T)
meta$Condition <- factor(meta$Condition)
rownames(meta) <- meta$Sample

# Load Htseq counts output
filenames <- list.files(path=file.path(dir,"Process/counts2/"),full.names=T)
filenames_short <- gsub(".htseq.count","",list.files(path=file.path(dir,"Process/counts2/"),full.names=F))
data1 <- read_tsv(filenames[1],col_names = c("id","Count"))
data_all <- filenames %>% lapply(read_tsv,col_names=c("id","Count")) %>% 
  purrr::reduce(full_join,by="id")
colnames(data_all) <- c("id",filenames_short)
data_all <- column_to_rownames(data_all,var="id")
data_all <- data_all[1:(dim(data_all)[1]-5),]
```
2. Run DEseq
2.1 Make DEseq object
```{r}
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(data_all, colData = meta, design = ~Condition) # Start with 410424 total peaks
colnames(dds) <- meta$Sample
keep <- apply(counts(dds), 1, max)  >= 50 # Keep columns where >= one sample >= 50 counts
dds <- dds[keep,] # 309297 peaks remaining
dds
```
2.2 Run DEseq
```{r}
dds <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds)
resultsNames(dds)
```

```{r}
res.BPPNM_EMT <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","Mes","Epi"), alpha=0.05, lfcThreshold = 1) #
summary(res.BPPNM_EMT)
```

```{r}
saveRDS(dds, file.path(dir, "Analysis/BPPNM_luc_mCherry_ATAC_DEseq2.rds"))
dds <- readRDS(file.path(dir, "Analysis/BPPNM_luc_mCherry_ATAC_DEseq2.rds"))
```

2.3 Run PCA and LFC shinkage
```{r}
# Data visualization using PCA
vsd <- vst(dds, blind=F)
plotPCA(vsd, intgroup=c("Condition"))
meanSdPlot(assay(vsd))
```

```{r}
res.BPPNM_EMT <- res.BPPNM_EMT[order(res.BPPNM_EMT$log2FoldChange),]
res.BPPNM_EMT
summary(res.BPPNM_EMT)
res.BPPNM_EMT_signif <- res.BPPNM_EMT0[(abs(res.BPPNM_EMT0$log2FoldChange)>0& !is.na(res.BPPNM_EMT0$padj) &res.BPPNM_EMT0$padj<0.05),]
res.BPPNM_EMT_signif <- as.data.frame(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif) # 91039 peaks DE
EnhancedVolcano(res.BPPNM_EMT, lab=rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT), x="log2FoldChange", y="padj", title= "BPPNM ATAC-seq Mes vs. Epi", xlim = c(-8,8), pointSize = 1, FCcutoff=1, labSize=4)
```
```{r}
# Generate background file
res.BPPNM_EMT0 <- results(dds, contrast=c("Condition","Mes","Epi"), alpha=0.05) #
summary(res.BPPNM_EMT0)
res.BPPNM_EMT_background <- res.BPPNM_EMT0[(!is.na(res.BPPNM_EMT0$padj) & res.BPPNM_EMT0$padj>0.05),]
res.BPPNM_EMT_background <- as.data.frame(res.BPPNM_EMT_background)
all_peaks <- readPeakFile(file.path(dir,"Process/macs2/all_peaks_cat_sort_merge_peak.bed"))
background_peaks <- all_peaks[all_peaks$V4 %in% paste(rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT_background),""),]
write.table(background_peaks,file.path(dir,"Analysis/background_peaks.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)
```

3. Gene annotation for differential ATAC-seq and GO analysis 
```{r}
# Up .bed file
#all_peaks <- read.table(file.path(dir,"Process/macs2/all_peaks_cat_sort_merge_peak.bed"),header = F)
all_peaks <- readPeakFile(file.path(dir,"Process/macs2/all_peaks_cat_sort_merge_peak.bed"))
mes_peakup <- all_peaks[all_peaks$V4 %in% paste(rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif[res.BPPNM_EMT_signif$log2FoldChange>0,]),""),]
mes_peakdown <- all_peaks[all_peaks$V4 %in% paste(rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif[res.BPPNM_EMT_signif$log2FoldChange<0,]),""),]
write.table(mes_peakup,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peak_up.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)
write.table(mes_peakdown,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peak_down_4.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)
# Read tables
mes_peakup <- read_table(file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peak_up.bed"),col_names=F)
mes_peakdown <- read_table(file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peak_down_4.bed"),col_names=F)
```

```{r}
my_annotation = TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene
anno_res.BPPNM_EMT <- annotatePeak(all_peaks, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
anno_mes_up <- annotatePeak(mes_peakup, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
anno_mes_down <- annotatePeak(mes_peakdown, TxDb=TxDb.Mmusculus.UCSC.mm10.knownGene)
# Add gene symbols
mes_up_df <- as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_up))
mes_up_df$geneSymbol <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(mes_up_df$geneId), column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first")
mes_down_df <- as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_down))
mes_down_df$geneSymbol <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(mes_down_df$geneId), column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first")
# anno_promoter
mes_up_promoter <- mes_up_df[mes_up_df$annotation %in% c("Promoter (<=1kb)","Promoter (1-2kb)","Promoter (2-3kb)"),]
mes_down_promoter <- mes_down_df[mes_down_df$annotation %in% c("Promoter (<=1kb)","Promoter (1-2kb)","Promoter (2-3kb)"),]

# Cebpb peaks
anno_all_df <- as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_res.BPPNM_EMT))
anno_all_df$geneSymbol <-  mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db, keys = as.character(anno_all_df$geneId), column = "SYMBOL", keytype = "ENTREZID", multiVals = "first")
cebpb <- anno_all_df[anno_all_df$geneSymbol == "Cebpb",]
# Match wtih gRanges object to get promoter region .bed files for motif analysis
mes_peakup_promoter <- mes_peakup[mes_peakup$V4 %in% mes_up_promoter$V4,]
mes_peakdown_promoter <- mes_peakdown[mes_peakdown$V4 %in% mes_down_promoter$V4,]
write.table(mes_peakup_promoter,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peakup_promoter.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)
write.table(mes_peakdown_promoter,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peakdown_promoter.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)

# Enhancer peaks
mes_up_enhancer <- mes_up_df[!(mes_up_df$annotation %in% c("Promoter (<=1kb)","Promoter (1-2kb)","Promoter (2-3kb)")),]
mes_down_enhancer <- mes_down_df[!(mes_down_df$annotation %in% c("Promoter (<=1kb)","Promoter (1-2kb)","Promoter (2-3kb)")),]
mes_peakup_enhancer <- mes_peakup[mes_peakup$V4 %in% mes_up_enhancer$V4,]
mes_peakdown_enhancer <- mes_peakdown[mes_peakdown$V4 %in% mes_down_enhancer$V4,]
write.table(mes_peakup_enhancer,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peakup_enhancer.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)
write.table(mes_peakdown_enhancer,file.path(dir,"Analysis/mes_peakdown_enhancer.bed"),sep="\t",quote=F,col.names = F,row.names = F)

# Visualize peak annotations
plotAnnoPie(anno_mes_up)
plotAnnoPie(anno_mes_down)
plotAnnoPie(anno_res.BPPNM_EMT)
upsetplot(anno_res.BPPNM_EMT)
# GO enrich
go1 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_up))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "BP", maxGSSize = 5000)
go2 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_down))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "BP", maxGSSize = 5000)
mf1 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_up))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "MF", maxGSSize = 5000)
mf2 <- enrichGO(as.data.frame(as.GRanges(anno_mes_up))$geneId, OrgDb = "org.Mm.eg.db", ont = "MF", maxGSSize = 5000)
head(go1, 10) %>% dplyr::select(ID, Description, pvalue, p.adjust) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Mes")
head(go2, 10) %>% dplyr::select(ID, Description, pvalue, p.adjust) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Epi")
```

3b. rGREAT enrichment analysis 
```{r}
h_gene_sets = msigdbr(species="Mus musculus",category = "H")
h_gene_sets = split(h_gene_sets$entrez_gene, h_gene_sets$gs_name)
h_gene_sets = lapply(h_gene_sets, as.character)
res_mes_up <- great(mes_peakup,h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10",mode='oneClosest')
res_mes_down <- great(mes_peakdown, h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10",mode="oneClosest")
plotRegionGeneAssociations(res_mes_up)
plotRegionGeneAssociations(res_mes_down)
```
```{r}
mes_up_tb <- getEnrichmentTable(res_mes_up)
mes_down_tb <- getEnrichmentTable(res_mes_down)
head(mes_up_tb, 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, genome_fraction, observed_region_hits, fold_enrichment,mean_tss_dist,p_adjust_hyper) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Mes")
head(mes_down_tb, 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, genome_fraction, observed_region_hits, fold_enrichment,mean_tss_dist,p_adjust_hyper) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Epi")
write.table(as.data.frame(mes_down_tb), file=file.path(dir, "Analysis/rGREAT_mes_down.tsv"),quote=F, sep="\t")
```
5b. Identify Genes from these pathways
```{r}
# Do GO analysis on promoter-related regions only 
res_mes_up_promoter <- great(mes_peakup_promoter,h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10")
res_mes_down_promoter <- great(mes_peakdown_promoter, h_gene_sets,"txdb:mm10")
mes_up_promoter_tb <- getEnrichmentTable(res_mes_up_promoter)
mes_up_promoter_tb <- mes_up_promoter_tb[order(mes_up_promoter_tb$fold_enrichment,decreasing=T),]
mes_down_promoter_tb <- getEnrichmentTable(res_mes_down_promoter)
mes_down_promoter_tb <- mes_down_promoter_tb[order(mes_down_promoter_tb$fold_enrichment,decreasing=T),]
head(mes_up_promoter_tb, 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, genome_fraction, observed_region_hits, fold_enrichment,mean_tss_dist,p_adjust_hyper) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Mes_Promoter")
head(mes_down_promoter_tb, 10) %>% dplyr::select(id, genome_fraction, observed_region_hits, fold_enrichment,mean_tss_dist,p_adjust_hyper) %>% datatable(elementId = "GO_Epi_Promoter")
plotRegionGeneAssociations(res_mes_up_promoter)
plotRegionGeneAssociations(res_mes_down_promoter)
# 1-2 genes associated per region, find genes associated to regions in each pathway

```

5c. Which genes are in the Il6-Stat3 or Inflammatory response pathway?
```{r}
# get gene symbols from GREAT results
hallmark_sets = msigdbr(species="Mus musculus",category = "H")
Il6_pathway <- hallmark_sets[hallmark_sets$gs_name=="HALLMARK_IL6_JAK_STAT3_SIGNALING",]$gene_symbol
inflammatory_pathway <- hallmark_sets[hallmark_sets$gs_name=="HALLMARK_INFLAMMATORY_RESPONSE",]$gene_symbol
# Get genes with promoter in DE peaks
il6_mes_up <- mes_up_df[mes_up_df$geneSymbol %in% Il6_pathway,]
inflammatory_mes_up <- mes_up_df[mes_up_df$geneSymbol %in% inflammatory_pathway,]
# Plot heatmap with labels of promoters
il6_up_table <- as.data.frame(table(il6_mes_up$geneSymbol))
il6_down_table <- as.data.frame(table(il6_mes_down$geneSymbol))
il6_table <- merge(il6_up_table,il6_down_table,by="Var1",all=T)
il6_table[is.na(il6_table)] <- 0
il6_table$Mes_net <- il6_table$Freq.x-il6_table$Freq.y
il6_table <- il6_table[order(il6_table$Mes_net, decreasing = T),]
rownames(il6_table) <- il6_table$Var1
il6_table <- il6_table[-c(1:3)]
pheatmap(il6_table,cluster_rows = F,cluster_cols = F,fontsize=8,color = colorRampPalette(c("blue","white", "red"))(50),breaks=seq(-15,15,length.out=50))
inflammatory_up_table <- as.data.frame(table(inflammatory_mes_up$geneSymbol))
inflammatory_down_table <- as.data.frame(table(inflammatory_mes_down$geneSymbol))
inflammatory_table <- merge(inflammatory_up_table,inflammatory_down_table,by="Var1",all=T)
inflammatory_table[is.na(inflammatory_table)] <- 0
inflammatory_table$Mes_net <- inflammatory_table$Freq.x-inflammatory_table$Freq.y
inflammatory_table <- inflammatory_table[order(inflammatory_table$Mes_net,decreasing=T),]
inflammatory_table <- inflammatory_table[c(1:60),]
rownames(inflammatory_table) <- inflammatory_table$Var1
inflammatory_table <- as.data.frame(inflammatory_table[-c(1:3)])
pheatmap(inflammatory_table,cluster_cols=F,cluster_rows=F,color = colorRampPalette(c("blue","white", "red"))(50),breaks=seq(-50,50,length.out=50))
il6_mes_down <- mes_down_df[mes_down_df$geneSymbol %in% Il6_pathway,]
inflammatory_mes_down <- mes_down_df[mes_down_df$geneSymbol %in% inflammatory_pathway,]
```

```{r}
# Calculate a transcriptional-accessibility score (averaged LFC of DE peaks or all peaks)
significant_peaks <- rbind(mes_up_df,mes_down_df)
significant_peaks$LFC <- res.BPPNM_EMT_signif[match(significant_peaks$V4,paste(rownames(res.BPPNM_EMT_signif),"")),]$log2FoldChange
# Get peaks in Il6 pathway
il6_peaks <- significant_peaks[significant_peaks$geneSymbol %in% Il6_pathway,c("geneSymbol","LFC")]
inflammatory_peaks <- significant_peaks[significant_peaks$geneSymbol %in% inflammatory_pathway,c("geneSymbol","LFC")]
# Calculate average LFC per gene
il6_averageLFC <- aggregate(.~geneSymbol, data=il6_peaks, mean)
plot_averageLFC <- function(peaks){
  averageLFC <- aggregate(.~geneSymbol, data=peaks, mean)
  averageLFC <- averageLFC[order(averageLFC$LFC, decreasing=T),]
  averageLFC <- averageLFC[c(1:30,(dim(averageLFC)[1]-30):dim(averageLFC)[1]),]
  rownames(averageLFC) <- averageLFC$geneSymbol
  averageLFC<- averageLFC[-c(1)]
  crange = max(abs(averageLFC$LFC))
  pheatmap(averageLFC,cluster_rows = F,cluster_cols = F,fontsize=8,color = colorRampPalette(c("blue","white", "red"))(50),breaks=seq(-crange,crange,length.out=50))
}
plot_averageLFC(il6_peaks)
```
